data.claim: Under pure event sourcing—where all system state is derivable by replaying the append-only log, no external mutable state exists, and every event is deterministic given its predecessors—resumption is safe iff the log is intact and complete up to some committed event N. State is reconstructed by replaying events 1..N, and resumption appends from N+1. Resumption must be refused when the run involved non-deterministic external side effects (tool calls, I/O, randomness) that cannot be replayed, or when external mutable state was modified outside the log.
